item.title: In 2023, New York mother arranged a fundraiser to erase strangers' medical bills after her death
item.description: Casey McIntyre's battle with stage four ovarian cancer led her to launch a remarkable campaign aimed at eliminating medical debt. Through her organization, Undue Medical Debt, she managed to relieve over $120 million in healthcare bills, directly benefiting more than 51,000 people. Her initiative stirred local community movements focused on medical debt relief, and fundraising efforts continue to support others facing similar challenges.

item.title: Phoenix man keeps 51-year-old home after ASU drops eminent domain case following public backlash
item.description: Arizona State University withdrew its eminent domain lawsuit against the historic Louis Emerson House to preserve the property. The decision followed widespread public opposition and a successful campaign led by John Young and Barry Schwartz. They generated substantial support through a petition that collected over 12,000 signatures. The university had filed the lawsuit seeking to acquire the property for a medical campus.

item.title: Iowa developer buys Valley West Mall for $11M, but JCPenney lease complicates plans
item.description: Threshold Capital has acquired the Valley West Mall property for $11 million in West Des Moines, Iowa. This ambitious mixed-use development aims to blend residential, retail, and entertainment spaces. Yet, they must navigate a challenging lease agreement with JCPenney that could impede progress. City officials are contemplating up to $110 million in public funding for this expansive project, with hopes of commencing construction following city approvals and finalized site plans.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'It was like a horror film': How Flydubai pilot was restrained with headphones
item.description: An Israeli passenger recounted how he and others restrained a co-pilot trying to take control of a flydubai flight. The incident started when a struggle was heard in the cockpit and quickly escalated. After the pilot was attacked, the plane nosedived, prompting passengers to spring into action. They managed to stabilize the aircraft while using headphones to restrain the co-pilot.
item.dc:creator: Yashasvi Vasistha

item.title: UK PM Burnham says may rejoin EU; France, Spain say 'welcome back'
item.description: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham has suggested the UK need to rethink its relationship with the European Union. He remarked that Brexit has not lived up to its commitment of regaining control, particularly over immigration matters. European leaders remain open to Britain's return, as polls reflect some public support; nevertheless, any formal talks would be postponed until after the next election, likely influenced by changing public sentiments.
item.dc:creator: Pranjal Pandey

item.title: UK sees ‘strong indications’ of Iranian role in RAF Fairford incident
item.description: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham stated there are strong indications of Iranian involvement in a recent incident. Five British men were arrested near RAF Fairford on suspicion of explosives and terrorism offenses. They were later released on bail after no explosives were found in the vehicles involved. The investigation is ongoing and authorities are collaborating with US officials for further clarity.
item.dc:creator: Yashasvi Vasistha

item.title: Ralph Bellamy’s former 1940s Glendale home finds buyer for $4.795 million after just one week
item.description: Ralph Bellamy’s former 1940s Glendale home has found a buyer for $4.795 million, just a week after hitting the market. The 1.25-acre property features a nearly 4,000-square-foot Tudor-style residence, equestrian facilities, a pool, hot tub and guest accommodations. Bellamy was known for films including His Girl Friday and The Awful Truth.

item.title: South West Water fined £7.8 million over hundreds of sewage spills across Devon and Cornwall
item.description: South West Water has been fined £7.8 million after pleading guilty to 18 charges linked to hundreds of sewage spills across Devon and Cornwall between 2015 and 2021. The incidents included 231 discharges at Harlyn beach and more than 336 illegal spills near Bodmin. The company has 56 days to pay the penalties.

item.title: Russian strikes kill 7 in Kyiv; weak air defence keeps Ukraine under pressure
item.description: Recent drone and missile attacks by Russia on Kyiv's energy infrastructure have tragically claimed seven lives. Ukrainian authorities have confirmed that such strikes have been consistent since the summer, but a noticeable increase has been observed in recent days. Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi stressed the significant nature of this large-scale attack.
item.dc:creator: Pranjal Pandey

item.title: An Ohio farmer facing $1 million in medical debt hoped a solar lease would pay $540,000 a year
item.description: In Ohio, farmer Wayne Greier's financial struggles intensified when a planned solar project fell through due to local resistance and new rules, leaving his family's renewable energy plans in jeopardy. Compounded by $1 million in medical debt from recent health issues, Greier was forced to offload land and equipment, jeopardizing his farming business. He has emerged as an advocate for farmers' property rights to help protect others from similar hardships.

item.title: Flydubai flight incident: Netanyahu says Israel preparing for other ‘potential threats’
item.description: A flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv experienced a serious incident that required an emergency landing. Following a cockpit altercation, one pilot was arrested and investigated by Saudi authorities. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu confirmed the situation was managed and the safety of passengers was prioritized. Warplanes were scrambled in response to potential hijacking fears but were later stood down.
item.dc:creator: Yashasvi Vasistha

item.title: 84 years together, 13 children and 120+ descendants: The Brazilian couple who held a Guinness record
item.description: Manoel Angelim Dino and Maria de Sousa Dino tied the knot in 1940 and enjoyed an incredible union lasting nearly 85 years. Their love blossomed into a large family, with 13 children resulting in a remarkable lineage of more than 120 descendants by 2025. The couple earned Guinness World Records' title as the longest-married living couple of different sexes.
